title: ‘Forgotten Island’ scores biggest DreamWorks Animation opening of all time in PH
summary: “Forgotten Island” has made Philippine box-office history, earning P97.2 million in its opening weekend to score the biggest opening for a DreamWorks Animation film of all time in the country.
